title: 19쪽
paragraphs: If memorizing these charts seems like a daunting task, have no worries. There's a much easier way to quickly estimate how likely you are to improve. If you're on the flop, count up all your outs and multiply by four. If you're on the turn, count up all of your outs and multiply by two.
Example for straight draw (8 outs) (number of outs)(2) = odds of improving (8)(2) = odds of improving 16% = odds of improving
